name: Disease
overview: Scripture reveals that diseases were both a consequence of disobedience and a means by which God demonstrated His power and holiness. God promised to protect His people from the diseases that afflicted the Egyptians if they obeyed His commandments, emphasizing His role as the healer (Exodus 15:26). The law required the removal of those with diseases like leprosy from the camp to maintain purity (Numbers 5:2; Leviticus 14:34), while also warning that disobedience would bring afflictions such as consumption and burning ague as judgments (Leviticus 26:16). God’s care extended to healing and blessing His people, promising to take sickness away when they served Him faithfully (Exodus 23:25).
